title: Hedging and Diplomacy in Academic Discussion / Gutangaza no kwihanganira mu kuganira ku gishushanyo
bridge: Mu gihugu cy'English, gutangaza (hedging) ni cyo kibazo kugira ngo ubone ukuri ari ukwiye kugira ubwoba. Ahubwo mu Icyongereza, aho kugira ngo ubone ukuri ari ukwiye kugira ubwoba, abantu bashaka gutumiza amagambo yabo no kugira ngo ubushake bwabo buhangane. Ibikorwa by'ubushake ni ukuntu abantu bashaka gutumiza amagambo yabo no kugira ngo ubushake bwabo buhangane. Ibikorwa by'ubushake ni ukuntu abantu bashaka gutumiza amagambo yabo no kugira ngo ubushake bwabo buhangane.
rule: Gutangaza mu gihugu cy'English cy'ishushanyo kirimo: 1) Amagambo y'ubushake: might, may, could (e.g. 'This might indicate...'). 2) Amagambo y'ubushake y'umuntu: I would argue, I tend to think, I feel. 3) Amagambo y'ubushake y'ubushake: perhaps, possibly, arguably, seemingly, apparently. 4) Amagambo y'ubushake y'ubushake: suggests, indicates, implies, appears (ahubwo 'proves' cyangwa 'shows'). 5) Amagambo y'ubushake y'ubushake: it could be argued that, it seems that, one might consider. 6) Gutangaza n'amagambo y'ubushake: not entirely, not necessarily, not wholly (e.g. 'not entirely convincing'). 7) Gutangaza n'amagambo y'ubushake: somewhat, rather, fairly (e.g. 'somewhat controversial'). 8) Gutangaza n'amagambo y'ubushake: if this were the case, it would... Ibigezwe by'ubushake: ntushobora gutumiza 'must' cyangwa 'definitely' mu bihamye by'ishushanyo (bifite ubushake); ntushobora gutumiza 'very' (tumiza 'highly', 'considerably'); kandi ukumbuye ko mu Icyongereza 'I think' ni cyo kibazo kuruta 'creo que' mu Icyongereza, ariko mu bihamye by'ishushanyo, 'I would argue' cyangwa 'It seems to me' ni cyo kibazo.

title: Strategic Hedging & Diplomatic Language / Urutonde rw’ishushanyo n’urutonde rw’amabwiriza
bridge: Mu gaciriyubwenge, ni byaba bikaze gusiba ibyo ubwiye gusubiza no kugira amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze, kandi mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze, kandi mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze. Ububiko bw’abanyarwanda ni ukubika amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze (e.g., 'Ibi ntibishoboka') cyangwa gusiba amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze (e.g., 'It is possible that...') mu gihe icyongereza kinshingiye kugira amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze. Nanone, kugira amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze ni ukubika amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze, kandi mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze.
rule: Urutonde rw’ishushanyo mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza rwakoreshejwe na: 1) Amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: perhaps, possibly, arguably, presumably, allegedly (mu mburyo w’inyubakwa cyangwa w’ahagati). 2) Imirimo y’ubwenge: seem, appear, tend to, suggest (bifuzwa amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze). 3) Amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: might, may, could (birushije kurushwa na 'must' cyangwa 'will'). 4) Amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: 'It could be argued that...', 'One might say that...' (bifuzwa ububiko bw’ubushishozi). 5) Amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: 'a bit', 'slightly', 'somewhat' (bifuzwa amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze). By’ingenzi: mu gaciriyubwenge, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze, ariko mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze + urutonde rw’ubushishozi (ntirushije -s). Akazi: 'Es posible que esté equivocado' → 'It is possible that I am wrong' (ntirushije 'I be wrong'). Mu miko, harimo amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze 'I'd suggest we consider...' mu buryo bwo kwiga icyongereza 'We should change...'. Kugira amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: 'I see your point, but have we considered...?' (ntirushije 'No, that's wrong'). Ububiko bw’ubushishozi ni ukubika amatsiko yuko ibyo ubwiye gusubiza bishobora kuba bimeze: 'I'm not entirely convinced that...' vs. 'I have reservations about...'.

title: Nuanced Literary Analysis: Register, Tone, and Implied Meaning / Ubuhamya bw’ibyo bihweyo mu ndango: Ubwoko, Inyungu, na Ubushobozi bw’Ibyo Bitangwa
bridge: Mu igifaransa, harakaze tubona tubikorera amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa n’uburyo bwo kushyira iby’umwuka mu gutanga amakuru. Mu icyongereza, C1 bishaka ko umenya neza uburyo bwo gutumisha amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa (might, could, would), uburyo bwo gutumisha umubare w’ibyo bitangwa w’umuntu (passive voice) kugira ngo ubone ibintu mu buryo bwo kwirinda, n’uburyo bwo gutumisha amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza (arguably, ostensibly). Abanyarwanda bashaka kugira uburyo bwo gutumisha amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa nk’ ‘it is possible that...’ mu buryo bwo kwirinda, ariko icyongereza bishaka amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza y’amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa (adverbs) cyangwa amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza (modal verbs), kandi bishaka ubwoba bw’uburyo bwo gutumisha ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa (present historic) n’ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa (past perfect) mu gutanga n’amakuru y’ibyo bitangwa by’ubwoko bw’icyongereza.
rule:
Kugira ngo ubone ibintu mu buryo bwo kwirinda mu gutanga amakuru y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza n’ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa, bishaka ko ubikorera:
1. **Ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa n’ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa**: Gutumisha amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa nk’ *suggest, imply, illustrate, portray* ahandi *show* cyangwa *tell*, n’uburyo bwo gutumisha amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza (however, moreover, consequently).
2. **Amatsko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza y’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa**: *Must* kugira ngo ubone ibintu mu buryo bwo kwirinda, *might/may* kugira ngo ubone ibintu mu buryo bwo kwirinda, n’ *could* kugira ngo ubone ibintu mu buryo bwo kwirinda. Kugira ubwoko bw’icyongereza bw’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa, amatsiko y’ibyo bitangwa y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza y’ubushobozi bw’ibyo bitangwa: 'Byari byinshi ko umukorwa yishakiye...' biravuga 'The author might be trying...' cyangwa 'Perhaps the author is trying...'.

title: The Art of Nuance: Hedging and Speculating / Ubushake bw’ibyo bishoboka n’ibyo bidukika
bridge: Mu gihugu, abagenzi b’ikinyarwanda bashimisha gusaba na gusaba kugira ngo babereke ibyo bashaka. Mu gishanga, ubushake bw’ibyo bishoboka n’ibyo bidukika bukoresha amagambo menshi, iby’amakuru n’amashusho menshi nk’ ‘may well’, ‘might as well’ cyangwa ‘I dare say’. Ubwokozi bw’inyoma ni ukubera ko mu gishanga nta mugenzi ushishana ushobora kugirira, kandi abagenzi b’ikinyarwanda bashobora kuba bashize hamwe cyangwa gusaba ‘maybe’ cyane kurushaho. Ni cyo kibazo kumenya ubushake bw’ibyo bishoboka n’ibyo bidukika kugira ngo ubone ubushake n’ubushishozi.
rule: Kugira ngo ushake n’ushyiremu mu gishanga C1, ubishaka: 1) Amagambo menshi y’ibyo bishoboka (may, might, could, should, ought to) hamwe n’ibyo bidukika byabo. 2) Amashusho y’ibyo bishoboka by’imyaka (might have, could have) kugira ngo ushake ku by’imyaka. 3) Iby’amakuru n’amashusho y’ibyo bidukika: arguably, presumably, allegedly, in all likelihood, by any stretch of the imagination. 4) Amashusho y’ibyo bidukika (hedges) nk’ ‘I would venture to say’, ‘It stands to reason that’, ‘One might argue that’. 5) Gusaba na ‘should/were’ kugira ngo ushake ku by’amakuru. 6) Kubika ‘seem/appear’ hamwe n’iby’amakuru cyangwa that-cláusula kugira ngo ubereke ibyo bidukika. Ibyo bidukika by’inyoma: nta mugenzi ushishana ushobora kugirira; amashusho y’iby’amakuru ni menshi koma nta mugenzi ushishana ushobora kugirira; ‘maybe’ ni cy’amakuru n’ubishaka ‘perhaps’ cyangwa ‘possibly’ mu by’amakuru by’ishango.

title: Nuanced Political Commentary / Ingano ya politik mu mutwe w’ibinyacumu
bridge: Mu igifaransa, harakoreshwa cyane imperatif n’amatsinda nk’ ‘il est possible que’ kugirango hishyurwa ibitekerezo bya politikye mu kanye. Mu Icyongereza, harakoreshwa ububiko bw’amatsinda nk’ ‘it is possible that’ na ‘it is likely that’ kugiranga hishyurwe ibinyacumu. Kandi, mu Icyongereza, amatsinda nk’ ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘should’ na ‘would’ harakoreshwa kugirango hishyurwe ibinyacumu by’ibitekerezo bya politikye. Kandi, mu Icyongereza, amatsinda nk’ ‘it is argued that’ na ‘it is believed that’ harakoreshwa kugirango hishyurwe ibinyacumu by’ibitekerezo bya politikye.
rule: Kuri ibitekerezo bya politikye bya kinyejana (C1) mu Icyongereza, harakoreshwa: 1) Amatsinda y’ibinyacumu nk’ ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘may’, ‘should’ (e.g., ‘The policy might backfire’). 2) Amatsinda y’ibinyacumu nk’ ‘it is argued’, ‘it has been suggested’, ‘it is widely believed’. 3) Amatsinda y’ibinyacumu nk’ ‘profound’, ‘utterly’, ‘deeply’, ‘marginally’. 4) Amatsinda y’ibinyacumu nk’ ‘while’, ‘whereas’, ‘even though’. 5) Amatsinda y’ibinyacumu nk’ ‘tend to’ kugirango hishyurwe ibinyacumu by’ibitekerezo bya politikye. Kurengera gutekereza cyane ‘I think’; ongere ‘I would argue’, ‘It seems to me’. Kandi, mu Icyongereza y’ikinyejana, imperatif ntirakoreshwa (usibye mu matsinda nk’ ‘suffice it to say’) kandi hishyurwa na ‘should’ cyangwa ‘would’.

Abashyiramo Icyongereza bashobora kugira ‘be likely to’ cyangwa ‘could well’ kugirango hishyurwe ibinyacumu by’ibitekerezo bya politikye. ‘It is probable that’ bishobora kugirwa mu matsinda y’itegeko cyangwa mu mashinga, ariko mu ibitekerezo bya politikye, harakoreshwa amatsinda nk’ ‘likely’ cyangwa ‘could well’.

title: Narratives with Perspective / Ibiganiro byoroshye bitangwa na urupapuro
bridge: Mu gaciri ya igifaransa, kugirango tubigane ku rupapuro rw'inyuma, tubyuka kubika ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect kugira twemere ibyabaye n'ibindi, kandi tubica ibintu by'indefinite kugira twemere ibyabaye mu gihe kimwe, kandi tubica ibintu by'imperfect n'ibintu by'indefinite mu buryo bw'urupapuro. Mu gaciri ya igishushanyamerike, ubwoko bw'ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect n'ibintu by'indefinite ni nk'ubwoko bw'ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect n'ibintu by'indefinite mu gaciri ya igifaransa, ariko kugirango tubike ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect mu buryo bw'urupapuro, tubyuka kubica ibintu by'past perfect, kandi ibintu by'past perfect by'igishushanyamerike birangwa kuri ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect mu gaciri ya igifaransa, kandi ibintu by'past perfect by'igishushanyamerike birangwa kuri ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect mu gaciri ya igifaransa. Nanone, igishushanyamerike bishimisha ibintu by'past perfect continuous kugira bigaterekeze ubwoko bw'ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect, kandi ibintu by'past perfect continuous by'igishushanyamerike birangwa kuri ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect mu gaciri ya igifaransa. Abanyarwanda bashobora gufata ibintu by'past simple mu buryo bw'urupapuro, kandi bashobora gufata ibintu by'past perfect mu buryo bw'urupapuro, kandi bashobora gufata ibintu by'past continuous mu buryo bw'urupapuro.
rule: Kugirango tubigane ibiganiro byoroshye byatangwa na urupapuro mu gaciri ya igishushanyamerike (CEFR C1), tubyuka kubica ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect, ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite, ibintu by'past perfect, n'ibintu by'past perfect continuous mu buryo bw'urupapuro. Ibintu by'past simple (e.g., 'she arrived') bigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect, kandi ibintu by'past continuous (e.g., 'she was arriving') bigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite. Ibintu by'past perfect (e.g., 'she had arrived') bigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect, kandi ibintu by'past perfect continuous (e.g., 'she had been arriving') bigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite. Kugirango tubike ibintu by'urupapuro (ibitekerezo, ibyishimo, ibintu by'inyuma, cyangwa ibiganiro by'inyuma), tubyuka kubica 'would' kugira twemere ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect, 'used to' kugira twemere ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite, n'ibintu by'modal' kugira twemere ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect. Ni byatanze kugirango tubike ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect mu buryo bw'urupapuro: ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect by'igifaransa ntibizatubaho mu buryo bw'urupapuro (byoshobora kubura 'used to'), kandi ibintu by'past perfect ntibizatubaho mu buryo bw'urupapuro.

common_error.explanation: Ibishushanyo byagerwaho kubera ko mu gaciri ya igifaransa, tubyuka kubica ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect ('salía') kugira twemere ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect. Ibintu by'past continuous ('was leaving') bigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite, ntibigaterekeza ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect. Kugirango tubike ibishushanyo, tubyuka kumenya ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect n'ibintu by'inyuma by'indefinite. Tubyuka kubica ibintu by'past perfect kugira twemere ibintu by'inyuma by'imperfect.

title: Advanced debate techniques / Ibyatanzwe by’ibitanzanyijo n’ibyo bishyura
bridge: Mu gaciri, gutanga ibyo bishyura bishobora kwinjirira n’amagambo nk’ ‘ariko’ cyangwa ‘ubwo burimwo’, ariko mu Icyongereza, ibyo bishyura n’ibyo bishimira bitangwa n’imibare y’amagambo nk’ ‘while it may be true that...’, ‘even granting that...’, ‘that said...’. Nanone, abashyira Icyongereza nk’indimi yabo ya mbere bashobora kwinjira mu icyo bishimiye kandi batagira ubwoba kurushaho kurusha mu gaciri kugira ngo bashimire ko batahuye; mu mithomo, ‘I take your point, but...’ ni byinshi kurusha ‘mbabimenye, ahubwo...’. Kaba ubwoba kwinjira ‘por supuesto’ nk’ ‘of course’ mu mibare y’ibyo bishimira: mu byatanzanyijo, ‘admittedly’ cyangwa ‘granted’ ni byo byihutirwa.
rule: Kugira ngo ubyatanze mu Icyongereza ku murongo wa C1, jya ubone ibyo mibare: 1) Gutanga ibyo bishimira + kushyura: ‘While it is true that [X], it is also the case that [Y]’ cyangwa ‘Even granting that [X], we must still consider [Y]’. Mu gaciri tushobora kwinjira ‘aunque’ cyangwa ‘si bien’, ariko mu Icyongereza, gutunganya nyuma ya ‘while’ ni ikintu gishobora kuganzwa kandi ikintu cyihutirwa ni ukubaka mu kanya nk’ikintu cyose. 2) Gutanga ibyo bishyura mu buryo bwo kugirira: ‘That argument does not hold up because...’, ‘This is a fallacy of false equivalence’, ‘I dispute the premise that...’. 3) Ibintu bishobora gutuma ubona ibyo bishimira: ‘I see your point, but...’, ‘Respectfully, I disagree’, ‘That may be true, but...’. Nta ‘yes, but’ uzashobora kwinjira; winjire ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’, ‘nonetheless’, ariko remera ko ibyo mibare birahindutse na ‘although’ (ibitangwa n’ubwoko butatoye kandi bidahindutse na ibintu bikwiye). 4) Ibintu bishobora gutuma ubona ibyo bishimira: ‘Consider the counterexample of...’, ‘This is contradicted by the fact that...’. 5) Gutumisha amagambo yo kugirira kugira ngo ubone ibyo bishimira: ‘That might be the case, but...’, ‘You could argue that, yet...’. Mu gaciri, byinshi kwinjira ‘pero’ na ‘sin embargo’; mu Icyongereza, kugira ngo ubone ubushishozi, winjire ‘however’ ku mwishura cyangwa mu gitatu, na ‘though’ ku mwishura wa clause: ‘The evidence is compelling, though.’

title: Navigating Academic Discourse / Ubuhamya bw'akademike
bridge: Mu gihugu, ubuhamya bw'akademike bwinshi bwigaragara ku gufatanya ibyago n'uburyo bwo kwinjira mu by'ubwoko, ariko mu liyongereza, ikizere kigaragara ku gutangaza neza no kugena mu gutanga umubare w'abantu, kandi bwinshi bikoresha umubare w'abantu w'umwanya. Ikibazo kihagije kuri kugira ubwoko bwinshi bw'ubwoko n'amagambo nk'ayo 'ni byo bisanzwe ko' ku liyongereza, aho bikenerwa 'it is important to' cyangwa 'it is crucial that' n'ubwoko bw'umwanya mu bindi binyoma. Nanone, ubuhamya bw'akademike bw'ongereza bwinshi bikoresha amagambo y'ubwoko (e.g., 'suggest', 'argue') mu buryo bwa kuri, kandi gihugu bishobora kuba byinshi. Reba ku ibyago n'ubwoko bw'amagambo, bishobora gutuma amagambo yawe atangaze neza.
rule: Kugira ngo uhamye neza mu liyongereza mu mpanuro y'akademike y'ibipimo bya C1, wabwirwa kumenya: (1) Amagambo y'ubwoko n'ubwoko (e.g., 'suggest', 'argue', 'maintain', 'contend') bwinshi bikurikirana na 'that' + igisubirano cy'ubwoko bw'umwanya (subjuntivo) mu binyoma by'ubwoko (e.g., 'The study suggests that the effect be considered'). (2) Ibigo by'ubwoko by'ubwoko (e.g., 'draw a conclusion', 'pose a question', 'address an issue', 'make a case'). (3) Kugira ubwoko bw'amagambo y'ubwoko (e.g., 'furthermore', 'however', 'conversely', 'in light of') bishobora gutuma amagambo yawe atangaze neza. (4) Ubwoko bw'umwanya mu binyoma by'ubwoko n'ubwoko (e.g., 'has been argued', 'might be attributed to') kugira ngo ubone neza. (5) Ibigo by'ubwoko by'ubwoko (e.g., 'implementation', 'assessment') kugira ngo ubone neza, ariko ntibishobora kuba byinshi, kubera ko liyongereza y'iyanu yikenera ubwoko bw'amagambo. Uburyo bw'ubwoko: amagambo nk'ayo 'suggest' na 'recommend' ntibishobora kuba byinshi; mu buryo bw'ubwoko, bikenerwa ubwoko bw'umwanya ('suggests that the data are...'). Hindura kugira ubwoko bwinshi bw'ubwoko (basta 'to') na 'due to the fact that' (koresha 'because').

title: Idiomatic Expressions & Colloquialisms / Ibinyabizanwa n’amagambo y’umwimukire
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, harimo ibinyabizanwa bifite umubare w’amagambo nk’iri mu Icyongereza (hera ‘gutegura ubwato’ bihuye n’aho ‘to break the ice’), ariko ibindi benshi ntibiterwa neza kugerwaho hanze y’icyongereza. Abashyirahamwe mu ikinyarwanda bashobora kugena mu gutumiza amabwiriza nk’ ‘gutegura’ + igisubizo (gutegura ubwato) mu Icyongereza, kugerageza ibyaha nk’ ‘I have hunger’ aho ‘I’m hungry’. Ubwenge mu Icyongereza bw’umwimukire busigura amagambo menshi n’ibinyabizanwa itari bifite icyo kimwe mu ikinyarwanda, cyane cyane kugirango ubone ko ari ibinyabizanwa, ntibinyabizanwa. Reba neza iby’amagambo y’amahitamo: amagambo y’umwimukire ari yo y’ingenzi kandi birashobora kugirira amahamya mu iby’umwimerere.
rule: Kugira ubone uri mu mubare w’C1, wabishaka kuba ufite ubumenyi bw’ibinyabizanwa n’amagambo y’umwimukire yifite mu magambo yo mu kuzuza. Ibinyabizanwa ni amagambo y’umwimukire yifite ubwoko bw’amagambo atandukanye (hera ‘break the ice’ = ‘gutegura ubwato’). Mu Icyongereza, ibinyabizanwa benshi birashobora kugena mu gutumiza amabwiriza n’ibyo bitandukanye n’ikinyarwanda. Soma ibinyabizanwa byose, ntibinyabizanwa, kandi reba neza iby’ubwoko: amagambo y’umwimukire (hera ‘gonna’, ‘wanna’) n’amagambo y’ubwoko bw’icyongereza (hera ‘to commence’). Harimo n’ibyo bitandukanye mu buntu: ubwenge, ubwenge n’ubwenge bw’ubushishozi (understatement) ni ibintu bifite mu Icyongereza cy’Ubuweru n’icy’Amerika. Kugirango ubihe ibyaha, koza mu iby’umwimerere n’ubishingiye ku ibyo bitandukanye n’ikinyarwanda.

common_error.wrong: I'm in the clouds thinking about my vacation.
common_error.correct: I'm on cloud nine thinking about my vacation.
common_error.correct_alt: I'm over the moon about my vacation.
common_error.explanation: Ibyaha byagerwaho hanze y’ikinyarwanda ‘gutegura ubwato’ (gutegura ubwato) mu Icyongereza. Mu Icyongereza, ‘to be in the clouds’ si ibinyabizanwa by’ukuri; ‘to be on cloud nine’ ni ibinyabizanwa by’ukuri byo kushimisha ubwenge, kandi ‘to have your head in the clouds’ ni ibinyabizanwa by’ukuri byo gutegura ubwato. Kugirango ubihe ibyaha, soma ibinyabizanwa byose, ntibinyabizanwa, kandi reba neza mu idikishonere y’ibinyabizanwa y’ikinyarwanda n’Icyongereza. Koza mu iby’umwimerere kugirango ubone neza uburyo bw’ukukoresha.

title: Hedging and Softening Strategies for Near-Native Fluency / Imirimo y’ibinyacumu n’ubushake kugira ubufasha bw’umwimukire
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, tubona amashusho nk’ ‘byari kuva’, ‘niba’ kandi ubwoko bw’inyandikorugero kugira ngo tubyume amatsiko. Mu Icyongereza, bikoreshwa neza amashusho nk’ ‘might’, ‘could’, amajambo nk’ ‘perhaps’ na ‘probably’, n’amatsiko nk’ ‘I was wondering’ cyangwa ‘It seems like’. Ibibazo by’ingirakamaro ni guhamya ubwoko bw’inyandikorugero bw’Ikinyarwanda hanze y’ubwoko bw’Icyongereza, cyangwa kugumana ubwoko bw’amajambo bwinshi buri kuri buri. Kugura ibyo mirimo byiza kuri wowe bizagufasha kugira ubushake n’ubufasha mu mico yose.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, ibinyacumu (hedging) bikozwe n’uburyo bwa: 1) Amashusho: ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘would’ (ahamagarweho ‘That might be an issue’ vs. ‘That is an issue’). 2) Amajambo n’amatsiko: ‘perhaps’, ‘maybe’, ‘probably’, ‘apparently’, ‘as far as I know’. 3) Amatsiko y’ubushake: ‘I was wondering if...’, ‘I'm not sure, but...’, ‘It seems to me that...’. 4) Amashusho y’ubwenge bwinshi: ‘I'd say’, ‘I tend to think’. 5) Ibibazo by’ubushake: ‘..., isn't it?’ (n’ubwo mu C1 bishimwa neza ubwoko bw’amajambo bwinshi). Ku bw’Ikinyarwanda, ntibikoreshwa ubwoko bw’inyandikorugero kuri ako mirimo; bikoreshwa ubwoko bw’amajambo n’uburyo bw’amatsiko. Mu mico y’ubushake, bikoreshwa amatsiko y’ubwenge bwinshi nk’ ‘I'd venture to say’ cyangwa ‘It could be argued that’. Mu mico y’ubwenge bwinshi, bikoreshwa amashusho nk’ ‘sort of’, ‘kind of’, ‘you know’.

common_error.wrong: I think that is a mistake.
common_error.correct: I'd say that might be a mistake.
common_error.correct_alt: It could be a mistake, possibly.
common_error.explanation: Mu Ikinyarwanda, ‘Ntekereza ko ari ibibazo’ ni ubwoko bw’amajambo bwinshi n’ubushake, ariko mu Icyongereza bishoboka kuba ubwoko bw’amajambo bwinshi mu mico y’ubushake. Abanyarwanda bashimiye kuri buri bashaka kushyiraho ubwoko bw’amashusho (might, could) n’ubwoko bw’amajambo (possibly, maybe) kugira ngo byume amatsiko. Nta kuba wakoze ibibazo byinshi ‘I think’ kandi ukoresheje amatsiko nk’ ‘I'd say’, ‘It seems to me’, cyangwa ‘I'm inclined to think’.

examples.original: He might have forgotten the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /hiː maɪt həv fərˈɡɑːtən ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Byari kuva yibukanye umugambi.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’amashusho ‘might’ bishobora gutuma ubwenge bwinshi, nk’ ‘byari kuva’ mu Ikinyarwanda, ariko ntibikoreshwa ubwoko bw’inyandikorugero.

examples.original: You could try calling her again.
examples.phonetic: /juː kʊd traɪ ˈkɔːlɪŋ hɜːr əˈɡen/
examples.translation: Wowe unganza kushaka kumwicisha cyangwa.
examples.note: ‘Could’ bikoreshwa kugira ngo ubushake, kuri buri bwinshi kurushaho ‘you should’.

examples.original: I would say that's a fair point.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd seɪ ðæts ə fer pɔɪnt/
examples.translation: Nari ntekereza ko ari ubwoko bwiza.
examples.note: ‘I would say’ bishobora gutuma ubwenge bwinshi n’ubushake kurushaho ‘I say’.

examples.original: Perhaps we should reconsider the plan.
examples.phonetic: /pərˈhæps wiː ʃʊd ˌriːkənˈsɪdər ðə plæn/
examples.translation: Byari kuva twebwe tubyume amatsiko y’uburyo bw’uburyo.
examples.note: ‘Perhaps’ ni ubwoko bw’amajambo bwinshi kurushaho ‘maybe’ kandi bikoreshwa ku mbere cyangwa mu gitatu cy’amatsiko.

examples.original: It's probably going to rain later.
examples.phonetic: /ɪts ˈprɑːbəbli ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə reɪn ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: Byari kuva kuri buri kuri.
examples.note: Mu Ikinyarwanda, ‘byari kuva’ bikoreshwa neza n’ubwoko bw’inyandikorugero, mu Icyongereza bikoreshwa gusa ubwoko bw’amajambo.

examples.original: As far as I know, the project is on track.

examples.translation: Kuri buri kuri, uburyo bw’uburyo bw’uburyo bw’uburyo.
examples.note: Aya majambo y’ubushake n’ubwenge bwinshi.

examples.original: I was wondering if you'd be free for a chat tomorrow.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juːd biː friː fər ə tʃæt təˈmɑːroʊ/
examples.translation: Nari ntekereza niba wowe unganza kugura igihe cy’inyandiko cy’icyuma.
examples.note: Kugura ubwoko bw’amashusho ‘I am’ kuri ‘I was’ bishobora gutuma ibibazo by’ubushake n’ubwenge bwinshi.

examples.note: Kugura ubwoko bw’amashusho n’ubwoko bw’amajambo bishobora gutuma ubwenge bwinshi n’ubushake.
